text: Patient: Dorothy Kim, age 71. Address: 55 Maple Lane, Berkeley, CA 94710. Dorothy is a retired nurse who moved to the Bay Area to be closer to family after her COPD diagnosis worsened. She is highly health-literate but has been struggling with medication adherence since her caregiver changed last month. Primary conditions: Type 2 diabetes, COPD (moderate), osteoporosis. Current medications: Metformin 1000mg twice daily, Tiotropium inhaler daily, Alendronate 70mg weekly (Mondays), Vitamin D3 2000 IU daily. Allergies: latex, contrast dye. Last physical: 2025-11-30 with Dr. Ramos. Upcoming: Endocrinology follow-up at UCSF scheduled 2026-05-12 — transport required. Grocery preferences: diabetic-friendly diet, no shellfish, prefers weekly delivery from Safeway. Staples: low-glycemic bread, leafy greens, chicken breast, almond milk, berries. Last grocery delivery: 2026-04-13 (12 days ago). Emergency contacts: daughter Susan Kim +1-510-555-0311, son James Kim +1-510-555-0422.
